title: Contains Duplicate
description: Given an integer array nums, return true if any value appears at least twice in the array, and return false if every element is distinct.
prompt: Implement function solve(nums) returning true if any duplicate value exists.

testCases.description: Because nums[0] == nums[3], we return true.
Because there are no duplicates, we return false.
Because nums[0] == nums[1] == nums[2], we return true.

title: Valid Anagram
description: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise. An anagram is a word formed by rearranging the letters of another, using all original letters exactly once.
prompt: Implement function solve(s, t) returning true if t is an anagram of s.

testCases.description: Because 'anagram' and 'nagaram' are anagrams, we return true.
Because 'rat' and 'car' are not anagrams, we return false.
Because 'listen' and 'silent' are anagrams, we return true.

title: Group Anagrams
description: Given an array of strings strs, group the anagrams together. You can return the answer in any order.
prompt: Implement function solve(strs) returning all anagram groups as an array of arrays.

testCases.description: Because 'eat', 'tea', and 'ate' are anagrams, 'tan' and 'nat' are anagrams, and 'bat' is an anagram of itself, we return [['eat','tea','ate'],['tan','nat'],['bat']].
Because there are no duplicates, we return [['']].
Because there are no duplicates, we return [['a']].

title: Top K Frequent Elements
description: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the k most frequent elements. You may return the answer in any order. The answer is guaranteed to be unique.
prompt: Implement function solve(nums, k) returning the k most frequently occurring elements.

testCases.description: Because 1 appears 3 times and 2 appears 2 times, we return [1, 2].
Because 3 appears 3 times and 2 appears 2 times, we return [3, 2].

title: Product of Array Except Self
description: Given an integer array nums, return an array answer such that answer[i] is equal to the product of all elements of nums except nums[i]. Must run in O(n) time without using the division operation.
prompt: Implement function solve(nums) returning an array where each element is the product of all other elements.
